name: sc-800
description: Audio Database National/Technics SC-800 ¥ 105,000 (around 1970) Commentary This is a stereo set with enhanced musical performance by using a cellular horn in the middle range. Receiver section In addition to the ITL-OTL circuit, the amplifier section is an OCL circuit without the output capacitor, which realizes direct connection between the amplifier and the speaker, and improves low-frequency distortion, frequency characteristics and damping characteristics. A full-scale IC is used for the equalizer circuit of the preamplifier section to realize a circuit resistant to noise. As a control function, it is equipped with circuits such as loudness control and high filter. The preamp section and main amplifier section can be used independently. A 4-pole MOS type FET is used for the FM tuner section, and excellent sensitivity and selectivity are ensured by using a 4-stage IF circuit. Switching system is adopted for FM multi-circuit. Equipped with FM-AM tuning meter. Player part The tone arm uses a pipe arm with an inside four scan seller. The cartridge is a semiconductor cartridge. Speaker part 3-way configuration. Equipped with a multi-sellerhorn type squaker in the mid-range, the mid-range playback capability is enhanced. It has a 20 cm cone woofer in the low range and a 6.5 cm cone tweeter in the high range. The enclosure is hermetically sealed. Other There was an interior box as an option sold separately in SC-800. This interior box was also sold as SC-800 Deluxe as a set. The interior box can be used as a record shelf or tape deck storage rack. It can be developed into a multi-amplifier system by adding a multi-channel divider (sold separately).
